berlin-z0-10.pmtiles (test fixture)

A cut of the Protomaps basemap daily build 20260811 (basemap version 4.15.1), made with
go-pmtiles 1.31.2 `pmtiles extract --bbox=13.08906,52.33946,13.76002,52.67465 --maxzoom 8`
(the bounding box of the Berlin LAU). The file name keeps the planned "z0-10"; the file holds
zoom 0 to 8 only, because zoom 9 and 10 pushed it past the 2 MB limit.

Data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0),
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/.
The tiles are a Produced Work of OpenStreetMap by Protomaps (https://protomaps.com).
Natural Earth data in the low zooms is public domain. The `landcover` layer is derived from
ESA WorldCover (CC BY 4.0, https://esa-worldcover.org); this fixture is used for tests only and
is not served.
